TM Apps by MD. Muklash Mia

TM Player and TM Sounds by MD. Muklash Mia — free, ad-free, open-source Android apps. Add this repo in the F-Droid app to install and update them directly.

Currently it serves 2 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://muklash-dev.github.io/fdroid-repo/repo
